privacy.title: PaiNovel Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Policy explains how the current version of PaiNovel handles information. The current build is a local demonstration and does not integrate accounts, advertising, analytics, crash reporting, or real payment services. We will update this Policy and store disclosures before enabling any such capability.

sections.heading: 1. Information we handle
paragraphs: By default, library items, reading progress, bookmarks, search terms, coin balance, reading and notification preferences, reviews, and tips are demonstration data held on the device or in the current process. PaiNovel does not upload them to a remote service.

Only when API_BASE_URL is explicitly supplied at build time does the Discover screen request a novel catalog from that server. Network infrastructure may automatically process connection data such as IP address, request time, and User-Agent. The current repository implements no persistent server logs, user accounts, or database.

sections.heading: 2. Permissions and device access
paragraphs: The Android release manifest declares no camera, microphone, location, contacts, photos, storage, notification, or advertising identifier permission. iOS declares no corresponding sensitive permission usage descriptions. Debug and profile Android builds declare internet access for development tooling only.

The current mobile app does not read user photos or files. The separate browser-based operations console can select covers, text, Markdown, or ZIP files; the browser parses these locally and may send draft data to its configured operations API. That console is not an end-user mobile feature.

sections.heading: 3. Third-party services
paragraphs: The current mobile app uses Flutter, flutter_bloc, equatable, and http. It includes no advertising, behavioral analytics, crash reporting, social sign-in, cloud storage, or payment SDK.

Before adding Google Play Billing, advertising, analytics, crash reporting, or another third party, we will identify the provider, data, purpose, sharing, and provider policy, and update the Google Play Data safety disclosure.

sections.heading: 4. Payments and virtual coins
paragraphs: The current recharge screen performs a local action explicitly labeled “Mock purchase.” It does not charge the user and does not integrate Google Play Billing. Chapter unlocks and author tips only modify a demonstration balance.

If a Google Play release later sells virtual coins, subscriptions, or digital content, it will use billing required by the applicable Google Play Payments policy and display pricing and terms. Payment credentials would be handled by the payment platform.

sections.heading: 5. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: The current mobile app does not offer account creation and has no PaiNovel-controlled user database. In-memory data disappears when the process ends; bundled content remains until the app is removed or updated. Enabling the current remote API does not add account persistence.

Because there is currently no account or remote user profile, there is no account-deletion flow. Users can clear app data or uninstall to remove device data. Before introducing account creation, we will provide both an in-app deletion path and a public web deletion path and disclose any data and periods that must be retained for law or security.

sections.heading: 6. Security and international transfers
paragraphs: We will apply reasonable transport protection and access controls appropriate to an actual deployment. Production server location, logging providers, and international transfers cannot be confirmed from the current code and must be added before those configurations are enabled.

sections.heading: 7. Children
paragraphs: The current code has no age gate or child-directed design. Before release, the publisher must complete content-rating and age-audience settings for target markets. The service should not be marketed as child-directed until that assessment is complete.

sections.heading: 8. Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update this Policy for feature, legal, or provider changes and will show a new effective date. Privacy questions may be sent to {{contact_email}}. Operator: {{operator}}.

terms.title: PaiNovel Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to PaiNovel. By using the app, you agree to these Terms. The current build is a functional demonstration; screens do not imply that every displayed capability is a live service.

sections.heading: 1. Service scope
paragraphs: PaiNovel demonstrates novel discovery and reading, including search, library, progress, bookmarks, preferences, reviews, virtual coins, chapter unlocks, and tips. Most current behavior uses local or in-memory mock data. Only the Discover catalog calls a configured API when API_BASE_URL is supplied at build time.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts
paragraphs: The current version does not support registration, sign-in, or account sync. The displayed reader name is fixed demonstration content and does not mean an account exists. Before accounts are enabled, we will add eligibility, security, termination, and deletion terms.

sections.heading: 3. Content and acceptable use
paragraphs: Use the service only for personal and lawful purposes. Do not infringe rights, bypass access controls, disrupt the service, upload illegal or infringing material, or use the service for fraud. Upload and publishing screens in the operations console are demonstrations not connected to a persistent production system.

sections.heading: 4. Virtual coins and payment
paragraphs: Coins, recharge, chapter unlocks, and tips are currently demonstration data. They create no real transaction, cash value, or refund entitlement, and displayed prices are not offers for sale.

If real digital transactions are enabled, the applicable store billing system will show final pricing, taxes, refund rules, and subscription terms. Virtual coins may only be used for eligible PaiNovel content and may not be redeemed for cash or transferred between users unless the law requires otherwise.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual property
paragraphs: The app, interface, marks, and operator-provided content are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. Unless expressly authorized, you may not copy, scrape in bulk, resell, or create a derivative service. A contributor or content operator must hold the rights needed for submitted material.

sections.heading: 6. Changes and termination
paragraphs: Demonstration features may be changed, suspended, or removed. After a production launch, material changes, paid entitlements, and termination will be handled under applicable law and the rules then published.

sections.heading: 7. Disclaimers and liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, the demonstration is provided as is, without a promise of continuous availability, persistent storage, or fitness for a particular purpose. Nothing excludes or limits liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited.

sections.heading: 8. Governing terms, disputes, and contact
paragraphs: Governing law, jurisdiction, and dispute venue depend on the operator and release markets, which remain unconfirmed and must be completed before publication. Contact: {{contact_email}}. Operator: {{operator}}.
